F-01_unclaimed_funds_lock.evidence: publishSettlement requires claimDeadline (1-365 days); releaseExpiredSettlement is permissionless after deadline; cancelSettlement authority-only before first claim

F-02_zero_claim.evidence: claim() now checks if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount()

F-03_no_emergency_control.evidence: setClaimsPaused() for emergency pause; cancelSettlement() for pre-claim cancellation; roots are never rewritten

F-04_duplicate_revocation.evidence: revoke() now checks if (revoked[tokenId]) revert IdentityAlreadyRevoked()

F-05_permissionless_claim.evidence: Design decision: proof-bound payment goes to leaf account. Standard Merkle airdrop pattern.

F-06_immutable_authority.evidence: Mandatory 2-of-3 Safe; Safe signers can rotate internally.

F-07_no_tokenURI.evidence: Signed AGORA Agent profiles remain canonical metadata.

F-08_api_authorization.evidence: Dual-gate production denial; explicit enablement; reservation-operator binding; rate limiting on all 7 mutation endpoints; MutatingOwner+CSRF on all state-changing routes

F-09_production_guard_spof.evidence: 5 layers: settings is_production, tokoin_local_control_plane_enabled (default False), route-level guard, state machine validation, Redis rate limiting (production fail-closed)

F-10_immutable_issuer.evidence: Distinct mandatory 2-of-3 Safe with signer rotation inside Safe.

new_findings.title: Solidity 0.8.30 has known bugs (none triggered)
new_findings.description: 4 known bugs in range (TransientStorageClearingHelperCollision HIGH, InheritanceOrderReversalOnStorageEndWarning MEDIUM, UnsoundSpillInMutualRecursion MEDIUM, LostStorageArrayWriteOnSlotOverflow LOW). None triggered: no viaIR, no transient storage, no custom layout, no mutual recursion.
new_findings.recommendation: Upgrade to solc 0.8.36+ when toolchain permits.

new_findings.title: Preflight checks attestation, not on-chain Safe configuration
new_findings.description: Preflight verifies SAFE_2_OF_3 environment variable attestation but cannot verify on-chain that addresses are deployed Safe contracts with correct threshold.

new_findings.title: setClaimsPaused can enable indefinite denial of service
new_findings.description: Settlement authority can pause claims indefinitely. If pause persists past deadline, claimants lose allocations. Mitigated by Safe signer rotation and releaseExpiredSettlement().
new_findings.recommendation: For testnet, acceptable. For mainnet, consider maximum pause duration.
